## About
Ferndale Collision & Auto Repair is a family-owned shop on Vester Street, dedicated to customer satisfaction and quality service. We repair collision damage, straighten frames, match paint, take care of mechanical work and detail cars.
Our staff of I-CAR certified technicians works to restore your car to pre-accident condition and get you back on the road in no time. Dennis Zoma is our general manager.
Customers mention Jon by name for walking them through their insurance claims, and one said Brenda at the front desk is so kind. One customer put it simply: ask for Jon at Ferndale Collision.

## Services
- Collision Services: Repair for vehicles damaged in collisions and auto accidents, bringing your car back to pre-accident condition.
- Frame straightening: Our shop has the technicians and the equipment for the precise, technical work of straightening a frame on today's complex vehicles.
- Custom painting: We paint replacement panels to match your car and bring back the showroom shine after an accident.
- Classic cars and street rods: We bring rusted, damaged and non-working vehicles back using the finest reproduction and original parts.
- Mechanical repair service: Complete services for all types of engines, including head work, timing changes, tune-ups and drivability work.
- Interior and exterior detailing: Engine degreasing, hand washing, hand waxing and wheel dressing.
- Complete Interior Cleaning: Dashboard, console, steering wheel, seats, glove box, door rubber, interior glass and mirrors, the rear window deck and ash trays.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Request one through our website. It's easy and fast, and you'll hear back quickly.

Q: Can I check on my car while it's in the shop?
A: Yes. You can check your vehicle online, by email, text message or Facebook.

Q: Do you stand behind your repairs?
A: Yes. To ensure quality, we guarantee our work.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
